marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 35 knots diminishing to northeast 30 early this
evening. Wind northeast 25 to 30 Sunday. Snow changing to scattered flurries Sunday evening.
Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 3. Freezing spray Sunday morning and afternoon. <br/>

marine.text: Seas 2 metres subsiding to 1 Sunday evening.<br/>
